name: Alignment-free sequence comparison benchmark
description: A comparative evaluation of alignment-free sequence comparison methods across standard datasets and metrics to assess accuracy and computational performance.
evaluation_method: AUC / Spearman correlation (for accuracy) and runtime (computational performance)
reputation: Well-known within computational biology for benchmarking alignment-free methods, though specialized to the sequence-analysis community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on biosequences; performance is dataset- and length-dependent. Benchmarks include both accuracy and runtime trade-offs.
